name: Raptor: Call of the Shadows
author: Scott Host, Skynettx, RetroGamer02
description_short: Vertical-scrolling shooter - fly the super-tech Raptor on interplanetary contracts for MegaCorp, upgrading 14 hard-core weapons.
description_long: Kill for cash! As a mercenary flying the super-tech Raptor, fly interplanetary missions to knock off top competitors of MegaCorp. Upgrade with 14 hard-core weapons. Jaw-dropping VGA animation & cinematics. Originally developed by Cygnus Studios.

external_resources.label: Raptor: Call of the Shadows GLB assets
external_resources.notes: Requires the original GLB asset files (FILE0002.GLB, FILE0003.GLB, FILE0004.GLB) from Raptor: Call of the Shadows DOS v1.2 (shareware or full). Place them in apps/raptor/ next to default.dol after install. You must obtain these files yourself — the registry cannot redistribute them.
